_help: Site settings. Edit, commit and push; Vercel redeploys and the next page load picks up the change. Plans: the prices here are what the pages SHOW (keep them equal to Stripe, then run npm run pages); the project limits here are also what the server enforces (api/_plans.js). See README 'Settings'.

riley._help: Riley's default voice per language, by the voice's name as her voice list in the designer shows it (designer.html?voices). Voices come from each visitor's device, so this is used only where that voice exists; blank lets her pick.
